{"text":"ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick 4K streaming device with Alexa Voice Remote (includes TV controls) | Dolby Vision; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Streaming on my Samsung TV interests me, but its 720p display gives me little reason to choose the 4K version.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Dot (2nd Generation) - Smart speaker with Alexa - White; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My recent purchases focus on practical electronics accessories; I have no current need for a voice assistant.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick streaming device with Alexa built in, includes Alexa Voice Remote, HD, latest release; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try this to add streaming to my Samsung TV alongside my DVD player; HD suits that screen.
ItemID: NA; Title: Echo Show 5 (1st Gen, 2019 release) -- Smart display with Alexa – stay connected with video calling - Charcoal; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My Fire tablet already provides a small screen, and I am not currently looking for a dedicated video-calling device.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Basics HDMI Cable, 18Gbps High-Speed, 4K@60Hz, 2160p, Ethernet Ready, 10 Foot, Black; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: A spare HDMI cable could be useful, but I would check my connections and required length before choosing it.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire TV Stick with Alexa Voice Remote, streaming media player - Previous Generation; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: It fits my interest in TV accessories, but I would choose the other HD streaming stick this time rather than buy two.
ItemID: NA; Title: Fire HD 10 Tablet (10.1" 1080p full HD display, 64 GB) – Black (2019 Release); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I already have a Fire 7 and have no clear reason to replace it right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: Made for Amazon SanDisk 64GB microSD Memory Card for Fire Tablets and Fire -TV; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this for more storage on my Fire 7, after confirming compatibility; memory cards are a recurring purchase for me.
ItemID: NA; Title: Cat 6 Ethernet Cable 1 Ft (6Pack), Outdoor&Indoor, 10Gbps Support Cat7 Network, Heavy Duty Flat Internet LAN Patch Cord, Solid High Speed Weatherproof Cable for Router, Modem, Xbox, PS4, Switch, Black; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I buy useful cables, but I have no current need for six very short Ethernet connections.
ItemID: NA; Title: Amazon Smart Plug, for home automation, Works with Alexa - A Certified for Humans Device; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My power-strip purchases address connection needs; they do not give me a current reason to add Alexa-controlled outlets."}
